Dr. Jerry Hsieh, DC is a specialist in the Gonstead Chiropractic method, serving patients through five clinic locations in Pleasanton, Concord, San Jose, Fremont, and Brentwood. He focuses on precise, corrective care for a wide range of conditions including neck pain, arthritis, low back pain, sciatica, headaches, digestive issues, and more.

Subscribe to the channel to see more Gonstead videos or visit https://www.interochiropractic.com.
